summary: Both edits carry every part of the intent with nothing added. The only problem is heavy repetition: the new node's note restates almost everything the modify note and the three edge notes also say. The two arms differ only in where the DI tokens sentence sits.

findings.detail: "depend on WebhookTasker instead of InternalTasker and pass its existing payloads through `deliverWebhook`" is stated on the webhook-dispatch modify note and again, almost word for word, on edge e-producer-webhook-tasker.

"WebhookSyncTasker calls the injected WebhookTaskConsumer directly and awaits its work" and "resolve the consumer through the existing dependency-injection container, and execute the same delivery operation" appear in the webhook-tasker node note and again on edge e-webhook-tasker-consumer.

"supply synchronous and Trigger.dev implementations to the Tasker base class" and "Use `ENABLE_ASYNC_TASKER` through that common mechanism" are in the webhook-tasker node note and repeated on edge e-webhook-tasker-base. That edge also repeats "preserve the tasker framework's established dispatch and error behavior" from the webhook-dispatch modify note.
"Keep payload construction and actual delivery semantics shared across both modes" is stated on both the webhook-dispatch modify note and the webhook-tasker node note.
